title: ship-v2 input
description: One ship-v2 run's input, closed at every level (references/back-loop.md section 3; references/ship-contract.md section 4). The shared fields, and `station`: what the invocation said, as data. The owner's words a run needs (MINOR fixes ordered, laps beyond the extra lap) arrive here verbatim, never remembered between runs.

input_version.description: the bump path a closed schema needs

run_id.description: this run's own id, single-use, one path segment

workspace.description: absolute path of the git work tree the core reads

run_dir.description: absolute path of this run's directory, outside the workspace

report_only.description: the run writes nothing outside its run directory

invocation.description: filled by the adapter's invocation.py, never typed

harness.description: the harness this run is driven from

session_id.description: the session this run happens in, as the adapter read it from the harness's own record

slice.description: the slice the invocation names (`/ship-v2 <slice> [doc]`); without it, select pauses and asks

words.description: the owner's words ordering the slice's MINORs fixed, verbatim; at least one character that is not white space (slice 2 check 1's C2-7)

minor_fixes.description: present only when the invocation ordered MINOR fixes (v1's step 3 and 4): they never gate and never trigger a recheck

count.description: how many laps beyond the one extra lap the owner ordered

words.description: his words, verbatim; at least one character that is not white space (slice 2 check 1's C2-7)

extra_laps.description: present only when the owner ordered more laps in words (CR-22): the only way a third lap happens
